Alex (CSM): Hey team — opening thread for Acme activation pulse + exec spotlight asks. Aim: 15-min exec slot next Tue. Need updated onboarding status slide, top 3 risks, and a single-page ask.

Marco (Eng): For ingest lag — root cause is parallel jobs limit. I can prepare a bullet: short-term config bump + timeline for infra fix. ETA: Fri EOD for slide note.
Sana (TPM): I'll slot demo clip (30s) showing reduced latency with cache on. Need test recording by Thu.
Priya (AE): Action items confirmed: 1) Ask slide — Priya (due Mon 12pm) 2) Onboarding health slide — Alex (due Mon 12pm) 3) Ingest mitigation note — Marco (due Fri EOD) 4) Demo clip — Sana (due Thu noon).
